components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Chili-red pill with a solid deep-red lip.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">สั่งอาหาร · ฿120</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 15px/1.2 'Prompt', 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f4b400; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #c0272d; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #9a1d22; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c62a37; }

components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 0; } .ds-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 16px; border: 1.5px solid #eadfcc; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; font: 600 14.5px/1.2 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #5a3a26; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f4b400; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip[aria-selected='true'] { background: #3b2417; border-color: #3b2417; color: #fff; }

components.name: Option Pills
components.description: Dish option choices inside the bottom sheet.
components.css: .ds-opts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1.5px solid #eadfcc; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; font: 500 15px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; color: #241e19; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s, border-color 0.12s; } .ds-pill small { font: 600 12.5px 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #c0272d; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f4b400; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill[aria-checked='true'] { border-color: #c0272d; background: #fff1ed; color: #9a1d22; font-weight: 600; }

components.html: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำหมูสับ ลูกชิ้น ไข่ต้ม฿60
components.css: .ds-dish { position: relative; width: 220px; border-radius: 20px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(60 36 20 / 0.06), 0 10px 24px -16px rgb(60 36 20 / 0.35); transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; } .ds-dish:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(60 36 20 / 0.06), 0 16px 30px -16px rgb(60 36 20 / 0.45); } .ds-art { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 5 / 4; margin: 6px 6px 0; border-radius: 16px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 55%, #fff6dc 0 38%, #fde7ad 70%, #f9d886 100%); } .ds-dbody { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 12px 14px; } .ds-dbody b { font: 600 15.5px/1.35 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #241e19; } .ds-desc { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: #776b5d; } .ds-price { padding-top: 6px; font: 700 18px/1.2 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #c0272d; } .ds-add { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #c0272d; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -6px rgb(192 39 45 / 0.7); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-add:hover { background: #9a1d22; } .ds-add:active { transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f4b400; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Cart Bar
components.description: Floating soy-brown cart summary at the bottom of the menu.
components.css: .ds-cart { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 360px; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 18px 8px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: #3b2417; color: #fff; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 16px 30px -12px rgb(40 22 10 / 0.6); cursor: pointer; } .ds-cart:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f4b400; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cart-ico { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; background: #f4b400; color: #3b2417; } .ds-cart-n { position: absolute; top: -6px; right: -6px; display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 5px; border: 2px solid #3b2417; border-radius: 999px; background: #c0272d; color: #fff; font: 700 12px/1 'Prompt', sans-serif; } .ds-cart-t { display: grid; flex: 1; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-cart-t b { font: 600 16px 'Prompt', sans-serif; } .ds-cart-t small { font-size: 12.5px; color: #d8c6b2; } .ds-cart-sum { font: 700 21px 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #f4b400; }

narrative.overview:
A warm Thai-Chinese noodle shop rendered as an app: chili red and egg-noodle gold over rice-paper cream, with soy brown as the grounding dark. The customer side is appetite-first and phone-first: big illustrated dish cards on soft golden radial "plates", a sticky category chip bar, bottom sheets for options, and a floating soy-brown cart bar. Everything is rounded, soft and tappable (44px minimum).

The staff side keeps the same family but turns functional. The kitchen board is a four-column status rail (new, cooking, ready, served) on a neutral kitchen background, where each card carries a 5px colored top edge and a 52px advance button colored by its next state. The admin uses a white top bar, pill tabs and plain bordered panels.

Depth is soft, warm-brown and layered, with a small hard "lip" (`0 3px 0`) under the primary red and gold buttons that makes them feel pressable.
keyCharacteristics: Chili red (#c0272d) for actions and prices, egg-noodle gold (#f4b400) for highlights and "in cart", soy brown (#3b2417) for the cart bar, selected chips and headings.
Pill buttons and chips; 20px dish cards; 28px bottom sheets.
Hand-drawn SVG food on tinted radial plates (five tones), never photos.
Warm brown-tinted soft shadows; red and gold buttons carry a solid 3px lip.
Realtime cues: pulsing green live dot, flashing gold outline on new kitchen cards, ringing bell on tables that call staff.

rules.name: The Red Means Buy Rule
rules.body: Chili red is for the action that spends money (add, order, primary) and for the price itself. Gold says "you have this"; brown says "you are here".

rules.name: The Status Lane Rule
rules.body: In the kitchen, each status owns one hue and every element in that lane (dot, count, top edge) uses it. The advance button takes the color of the next status.

dos: Do use chili red (#c0272d) for buy actions and prices, gold (#f4b400) for "in cart" and focus, soy brown (#3b2417) for selected navigation.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more on the customer side and 52px for kitchen actions.
Do draw food as SVG on one of the five radial plate tones.
Do keep each kitchen status in its own hue across dot, count, card edge and button.
Do use two-step inline confirms for destructive actions.
donts: Don't use cool greys or pure-black shadows on cards; shadows are brown-tinted.
Don't introduce a second display font; Prompt carries all headings, prices and numbers.
